items.text: 負責企業軟體（eQMS）導入、系統設定（Configuration）及功能配置，協助客戶與合作夥伴成功建置系統。
與客戶進行需求訪談（Discovery）及需求分析（Requirement Analysis），深入了解業務流程，並將業務需求轉化為最適合的 eQMS 解決方案。
執行系統功能設定、客製化（Customization）及功能優化，以符合客戶需求。
並執行測試計畫（Test Plan）、測試案例（Test Case）及測試腳本（Test Script），確保系統功能及品質符合預期。
協助系統整合（System Integration）、部署（Deployment）及正式上線（Go-Live），確保專案順利交付。
建立及配置概念驗證（Proof of Concept, POC），展示系統功能並驗證客戶需求。
執行及支援電腦化系統驗證（Computer System Validation, CSV），確保系統符合 GxP 法規、品質管理要求及業界最佳實務。
與專案經理（Project Manager）、技術工程師（Technical Engineer）及國內外跨部門導入團隊密切合作，確保專案如期且高品質完成。
與公司內部相關團隊合作，提供技術支援、系統問題分析及故障排除（Troubleshooting）。
提供客戶教育訓練、技術支援及系統上線後的持續服務，協助客戶成功使用系統。
與業務團隊合作，支援產品展示（Demo）、概念驗證（POC）及技術簡報（Technical Presentation），協助提供最佳解決方案。
維護並深化與重要客戶及合作夥伴的良好合作關係，協助客戶持續優化品質管理流程。
遵循、維護並持續改善公司內部品質管理系統（QMS）、技術文件及導入流程。
運用邏輯分析能力及問題解決能力，協助客戶解決技術挑戰，並提供有效的系統導入與應用建議。
Lead and support the implementation, configuration, and functional setup of enterprise software solutions (eQMS) for customers and business partners.
Conduct customer discovery sessions and requirements analysis to understand business needs and translate them into effective eQMS solutions.
Configure, customize, and enhance software functionality to meet customer requirements.
Develop and execute Test Plans, Test Cases, and Test Scripts to ensure software quality, functionality, and successful implementation.
Support system integration, production deployment, and Go-Live activities to ensure smooth project delivery.
Develop and configure Proof of Concept (POC) demonstrations to validate customer requirements and showcase system capabilities.
Perform and support Computer System Validation (CSV) activities, ensuring compliance with GxP regulations, quality standards, and industry best practices.
Collaborate closely with Project Managers, Technical Engineers and cross-functional global implementation teams to deliver high-quality projects on schedule.
Interface with internal stakeholders to provide technical support, resolve system issues, and troubleshoot software-related challenges.
Deliver customer training, technical support, and ongoing post-implementation services to ensure customer success.
Partner with the Sales team to conduct product demonstrations, technical presentations, and solution discussions with prospective customers.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers and business partners, supporting the continuous optimization of their quality management processes.
Comply with, maintain, and continuously improve internal Quality Management Systems (QMS), technical documentation, and implementation procedures.
Collaborate with national and international software implementation teams, sharing knowledge and supporting global project delivery.
Apply analytical thinking and creative problem-solving skills to address customer challenges and recommend effective technical solutions.
